epics.title: Knowledge Base Statistics and Analytics Reporting
epics.jtbd: When an Administrator wants to analyze the usage of the knowledge base, I want to retrieve compiled reports of popular search queries, document views, and download statistics, so that we can optimize educational materials and monitor compliance.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to compile usage statistics from hours to under 2 seconds
requirements: R1: Implement stats retrieval endpoint for usage analytics

slices.title: Implement Analytics Reporting Endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing the analytics endpoint for this epic, I want to compile and return usage statistics, so that administrators can access accurate reports.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given recorded user analytics exist in the database
When an Administrator requests the statistics report endpoint
Then the server returns a structured report of queries, views, and downloads
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce missing analytics endpoint errors from 1 to 0

slices.title: QA Analytics Reporting Endpoint
slices.jtbd: When testing the analytics endpoint for this epic, I want to verify the correctness of the aggregated statistics, so that reports contain reliable data.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a seeded database with known search queries and document views
When the statistics endpoint is called
Then the returned JSON report exactly matches the expected aggregated counts
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase analytics test coverage from 0 to 100%

epics.title: System Backup and Database Archive Utility
epics.jtbd: When the system faces a hardware failure or data corruption, I want to be able to create and download complete backups of the database, metadata, and physical files, so that we can restore the knowledge base and avoid data loss.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce full backup generation time from hours to under 5 minutes
requirements: R1: Implement database, metadata, and file archival endpoint

slices.title: Implement System Backup Endpoint
slices.jtbd: When building the backup endpoint for this epic, I want to compile the SQL schema, seed data, and documents into a compressed archive, so that secure backups can be exported.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated Administrator
When they trigger the backup endpoint
Then the system compiles the database and files into a timestamped compressed archive and streams it

slices.title: QA System Backup Endpoint
slices.jtbd: When testing the backup endpoint for this epic, I want to verify the contents of the generated archive, so that we ensure no data is lost during export.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a mocked file system and database state
When the backup endpoint is triggered
Then the returned compressed archive contains the correct SQL dump and physical files
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase backup feature test coverage from 0 to 100%

epics.title: Fuzzy Search and Typo Correction Support
epics.jtbd: When a user enters a search query with spelling errors or typos, I want the system to match relevant documents and auto-correct or suggest correction terms, so that the search process is efficient and user-friendly.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce zero-result searches due to typos from 15% to 0%
requirements: R1: Implement fuzzy matching and typo correction in backend search route

slices.title: Implement Fuzzy Search in Backend
slices.jtbd: When updating the search route for this epic, I want to integrate Levenshtein distance or fuzzy matching, so that typo-tolerant document results are returned.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a document titled 'Положение о практике' exists
When a user searches for 'Полажение о практик'
Then the search returns the matching document and provides a spelling correction hint
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unmatched typo queries from 1 to 0

slices.title: QA Fuzzy Search and Typo Correction
slices.jtbd: When verifying the search route for this epic, I want to ensure fuzzy matching accurately returns relevant documents, so that typo-tolerant search works as expected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:

slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase fuzzy search test coverage from 0 to 100%
